why: The project's 300 MW load assumes 121 diesel generators (2,500 kW each, total 302.5 MW) yielding an estimated NOx potential to emit of 1,067 tpy, exceeding the 100 tpy major-source threshold under 40 CFR 70.2, triggering a Title V operating permit requirement. Washington County's moratorium (ORD-2026-12) effective June 30, 2026, imposes a deferral on data center applications countywide for a period of six months per the draft ordinance, though the press release and dataset quote a twelve-month moratorium, leaving the actual duration contested. The moratorium exempts uses with a current Certificate of Use & Occupancy as of the effective date, but the evidence does not establish whether the parcel at 100 W Washington St holds such a certificate. Because the site lies within Hagerstown city limits, which has its own zoning, the moratorium's reach into the incorporated city is unconfirmed. Because the local moratorium's applicability is unknown and the Title V permit is a major federal requirement, the project's viability cannot be determined without confirmation.
